name: A Date with the Monster in My Closet
source:
You return to your bedroom after a long day at work, and you are so tired that you can't even change out of your work clothes.
The moment you reach the bed, you fall asleep; but soon after that, you hear some strange noises coming from the bedroom's closet...
translation:
结束一天的工作后，你回到卧室，你累得连工作服都来不及换。
当你一到床上，你就睡着了；但不久之后，你听到卧室的衣柜里传来一些奇怪的声音……
